§6Designing & Recycling an RBMK

§aBuild it right, burn fuel efficiently, and reprocess the waste.

§6Beginner Design: The Standard§f:
1 Steam Channel, 4 Fuel Channels, 8 Boron Absorbers, 4 Graphite Moderators, 18 Cover Panels. Output: §e3.75 MHE/s§f with MEP fuel.

§6Design Rules§f:
• Place steam channels diagonally from fuel rods for maximum heat capture
• Use moderators between fast-neutron sources and slow-neutron fuels
• Seal everything with cover panels
• Use reflectors on low-power fuels only, never with balefire/digamma

§6Closed-Loop Cooling§f: Condense steam back to water. 100% efficiency. Never void fluids.

§6Fuel Recycling§f:
• Remove rods at ≥1% depletion when they stop contributing flux
• Cool below §e50°C§f (let sit or use Spent Fuel Pool Drum, 12 rods each)
• Uncraft in 2x2 grid: 8 spent pellets + empty rod
• Process pellets in §bSILEX§f. Outputs vary by depletion level (5 tiers, each 20%)

§6Xenon-135§f: Burns off with strong flux. Reduces recycling yields if extracted.

§cWARNING:§f Test designs in creative with §egamerule dialDisableMeltdowns true§f first.
